stage1.impression: A warm, all-oak box with two red acrylic monitors on terrazzo blocks either side of a glowing multicolour ring globe. It reads as a clean CG showroom, not a night photograph: the frame is too bright and evenly lit, the floor is a blotchy camouflage pattern rather than end grain, the slat walls are smooth and stretched, the terrazzo chips are oversized, and there is no sign of life. A design magazine would not run it as a specific, well-made place; the speakers and the globe make it distinctive, but the room around them is a generic timber box.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median between 30 and 48 with deep but readable shadows between the pools of light (now 64.7)
End-grain oak floor that reads at 1:1 as small rectangular end-grain blocks with rings and checks, not hexagonal camouflage blobs
Oak slat walls and lid with real grain scale, slat shadow gaps and variation between slats, not one smooth stretched texture
Tropos pair as the brightest, most readable objects in the frame (speaker region median >= 45, horn not crushed) with the interior baffles reading as tinted acrylic rather than flat salmon plastic
Mother EARF's coloured shadow on the floor reading as saturated colour, not a white blown pool
Lived-in props: a lounge chair readable in frame, a record out of its sleeve, a glass
No visible render noise on the acrylic and walls at 1:1

defects.what: Too bright overall for a night listening room: lum_median 64.7, lum_mean 67.2, only 22.8 % of pixels below 40
Right slat wall much brighter than the left (median 90.2 vs 50.6), flat fill, rising toward the frame edge (profile 70 -> 111)
End-grain floor reads as large hexagonal/camouflage blotches, a procedural texture at the wrong scale, median 71.5
Mother EARF's floor pool is a near-white wash (median 123.7, p95 200.9); the coloured shadow is mostly lost, only a faint green/pink sliver
Terrazzo plinth chips oversized and high contrast, reads like a granite print, same pattern on all three plinths
Ceiling/lid slats show a stretched, repeating CG grain
Lone bluish haze shaft at top left with no visible source
Left speaker interior boards read as flat pale salmon plastic; speaker median only 33.1; visible grain noise on the acrylic
Left horn crushed in its throat (crush_pct 7.2, p5 2.8)
Lounge chair cut by the right frame edge, unreadable; rug at bottom right is a flat grey slab (median 103.6, range 45.7)
Left foreground oak panel flat and bright (median 76.5), no grain detail, reads as a plain board
Back console with black boxes is anonymous; no records, glasses or other signs of use anywhere

changes.problem: The frame is exposed like a daytime showroom, not a night room.
changes.expected: Frame median falls to roughly 42 to 46; walls step down into shadow while the lit objects keep their highlights.

changes.problem: The room fill flattens the walls and lifts the right wall far above the left, removing the pools-and-dark rhythm.

evidence.measured: median 90.2 vs left wall 50.6; x-profile rises 70 -> 111 toward the edge

change.setting: inside the lantern: the trap area 0.5 W/m2 and fill area 0.08 W/m2

changes.expected: Right wall drops to about the left wall's level and falls off into the corner; light reads as coming from the spots.

changes.problem: The Tropos pair is darker than the walls behind it, so it is not the hero once exposure comes down.

evidence.measured: left speaker median 33.1, right 44.1; horn throat crush 7.2 %

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair 2 x spot

changes.expected: Speakers glow through their acrylic and become the brightest masses besides Mother's rims; horn throat opens up.

changes.problem: The end-grain floor reads as camouflage blotches, the single biggest CG tell.

evidence.measured: crop at 2x: irregular hexagonal patches about 60-100 px wide, no rings, no joints

change.from: large procedural cell pattern, uniform tone
change.to: rectangular end-grain blocks about 60 x 90 mm in a running bond, visible growth rings and radial checks per block, tone varying +-10 % block to block, satin oil sheen with roughness 0.45

changes.expected: Floor reads as real end-grain parquet at 1:1 and catches the pools of light as soft broken highlights.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's spot is so strong that her coloured shadow washes to white on the floor.

evidence.measured: median 123.7, p95 200.9; colour only a faint sliver at the pool edge

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF 1 x spot

changes.expected: The disc colours project as saturated arcs on a darker floor instead of a white ellipse.

changes.problem: Oak slat walls and lid read smooth and stretched, and the left foreground panel is a flat bright board.

evidence.measured: median 76.5, lum_range 39.9, no grain at 1:1; ceiling crop shows a repeating stretched grain

change.from: one stretched grain map, light pinkish tone
change.to: per-slat randomised grain offset and +-8 % tone, real grain scale (rays and pores visible at 1:1), darker oiled tone (about 15 % lower albedo), 6 mm shadow gaps between slats

changes.expected: Walls read as real oiled oak and recede; the foreground panel darkens and shows grain.

changes.problem: Nothing says anyone uses this room.

evidence.measured: console top shows only two black boxes; no records, glasses or coats in frame

change.to: a record out of its sleeve leaning against the console, the sleeve face-down on top, one tumbler with a finger of whisky on the left plinth's floor side, a folded wool throw on the lounge chair

changes.expected: Small specular highlights on vinyl and glass; the room reads lived-in.

changes.problem: The lounge chair is cut by the frame edge and the rug is a flat slab, so the bench viewpoint and seating are not read.

evidence.measured: chair visible only as a sliver of legs; rug median 103.6, range 45.7

change.to: move 0.4 m back and 0.3 m toward +y (about [19.3, 2.97, 1.15]) at 32 mm so one lounge chair's arm and seat sit in the right foreground, rug and chair dark in the near plane

changes.expected: A seated listener's viewpoint with a dark foreground frame; the pair and Mother remain centred.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce Mother EARF's rainbow rim colours so the only saturated colour comes from the speakers
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF and her tinted discs are fixed by the card; this caps the 'one colour' criterion.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos interior boards read less like flat salmon plastic by changing their tint or construction
out_of_scope.why: The speaker itself (shape, colour, parts) is not to be changed; only its lighting (c3) can help.

out_of_scope.request: Show the lantern's slotted baffle, amber fin band or porch to make it a specific place
out_of_scope.why: The card defines this frame as inside the lantern from the back bench; those elements are outside this view.
